| Candidate coverage | Direct source locator and audit result |
|---|---|
| Q7–10 | pp. 7–9, 1.2.1–1.2.7: appropriate local estrogen discussion, distinguish systemic HRT, and treat active infection before trigger-specific prophylaxis. Breast cancer history requires the linked menopause guidance and individualized evaluation. |
| Q11–14 | pp. 9–10, 1.2.8–1.2.11: selected nonpregnant patients, previous treatment adequacy, avoid alkalinizing agents, follow-up by six months then annually, specialist input in pregnancy. Keys B/D/D/B consistent with these recommendations. |
| Q15, Q25 | p. 6, 1.1.4: specialist evaluation for repeated upper infections and male urinary-system presentations. |
| Q20–21, Q30 | pp. 11–14, 1.2.12–1.2.17: individualized risk/benefit assessment and reassessment no less often than six monthly for daily antibiotics. |
| Q19 | 1.3.4, extracted text only: probiotic benefit remains uncertain. |
| Source-based adaptation | p. 6, 1.1.2: differing organism strain/species supports reinfection. No official SCTIMST key authentication inferred. |
